description: Finds treaties laid before the UK Parliament by keyword, with the treaty name, command paper number, treaty series citation, signed and laid dates, lead department, whether the scrutiny period has concluded so the Government can ratify, and any scheduled debate. For trade lawyers, exporters and academics checking UK treaty scrutiny under the Constitutional Reform and Governance Act 2010. Source: UK Parliament Treaties API. It does not give treaty text beyond a GOV.UK link. (cost: 1 credit)

q.description: string, required, word or phrase in the treaty, e.g. trade

take.description: integer, optional, results to return 1-100, default 10

name: treaty_search
